name: Tears substitute
subtitle: Eye Drops
title: Tears substitute
description: This category comprises artificial tear formulations engineered to replicate natural tear fluid, restore moisture to the ocular surface, and stabilize the tear film. These drops provide soothing relief from dry eye syndrome, burning, fatigue, and irritation caused by environmental stressors, contact lens wear, or digital screen exposure.
note: For professional and consumer guidance, refer to the product pack and qualified healthcare professionals. This website does not replace medical advice.

name: ANTIBIOTICS
subtitle: Drops
title: ANTIBIOTICS
description: MOXIBRO Eye Drops is a single-active, prescription-grade antibiotic ophthalmic solution. It belongs to the 4th-generation fluoroquinolone class and is used to treat bacterial eye infections such as bacterial conjunctivitis (pink eye), corneal ulcers, and post-surgical ocular bacterial infections.
note: Refer to the product pack and qualified healthcare professionals for appropriate guidance.

name: Steroids and NSAIDS
subtitle: Drops
title: ANTIBIOTICS with steroids and NSAIDS
description: This category encompasses therapeutic, prescription-grade ophthalmic formulations—including broad-spectrum antimicrobial agents, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), and corticosteroids. These drops are used to treat or prevent bacterial ocular infections and manage postoperative pain, swelling, and tissue inflammation.
note: Refer to the product pack and qualified healthcare professionals.

name: Antioxidants
subtitle: Tablets
title: Specialized formulation
description: This category comprises oral nutraceutical supplements formulated with potent antioxidants, carotenoids, essential fatty acids, amino acid derivatives, and essential vitamins and minerals.
